meta.name: ReelGuru / Tally
meta.description: Night-studio broadcast language. An ink-black canvas lit by one tally-red 'you're live' light; heavy variable grotesk that stretches for emphasis; glass slabs and a titanium phone floating in real 3D. The page is a 30-second reel you scrub with your scroll.
source_references: Brief: deep ink/near-black canvas, one vivid electric accent, modern grotesque display type, glassy 3D surfaces, Awwwards-level 2026 craft
Brand metaphor: the camera's REC/tally light, the moment of 'You shoot.'
Content source: ReelGuru v2 index.html (copy + structure kept verbatim)
Explicitly rejected: v2 warm cream/yellow editorial serif look (Instrument Serif on paper, lime + clay)

color.palette_type: monochromatic cool neutrals + single hot accent (complementary temperature)

primary.role: Ink canvas: page background, 3D scene void, text on accent

secondary.role: Ice: glass tint, cool fill/rim light, hairline highlights (only at low alpha, never as a flat fill)

accent.role: Tally red: primary CTAs, live/REC states, emphasis words, playheads, the single full-bleed 'on air' moment (final CTA)

neutral.usage: #F3F4F6 bone = primary text on ink (18.9:1); #C9CDD4 = secondary text; #8B919C = muted/meta text (6.3:1); #5A606B = decorative only (3.2:1, large text or non-text); #2A2E36 = strong hairline; #161920/#0E1014 = raised surfaces; #07080A = canvas

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast: bone on ink for text; ink on tally for filled buttons (6.0:1); tally-on-ink only for display-size emphasis (5.6:1); depth from glow and glass, not from mid-grey fills

font_families.heading: Archivo (variable: wght 400-850, wdth 85-125), self-hosted subset
font_families.mono: JetBrains Mono (variable wght 400-600), self-hosted subset: overlines, timecodes, labels

typography.font_style_notes: One grotesk family used across its width axis instead of a second display face: headlines set heavy at 92% width with tight negative tracking; emphasis words jump to 125% width in tally red (the stretch replaces italics/serifs). Mono carries the broadcast/editing vocabulary: timecodes, REC, slot times.

spacing.section_rhythm: Sections breathe at clamp(96px, 14vw, 200px); pinned sequences (hero, how-it-works) extend with scroll distance instead of padding; dense UI (tabs, price card) packs tighter at 16-24px

layout.grid_system: 12-column fluid grid, content anchored left, display type allowed to break the grid and bleed under 3D

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px hairlines (bone at 8-14% alpha) with a brighter top edge to fake a light source
shape.divider_style: 1px hairline plus timeline ruler ticks (mono timecodes) for sequential content

elevation.shadow_style: layered: deep ambient drop + inner top highlight + optional tally glow
elevation.depth_cues: blur/glass, overlapping layers, real 3D occlusion (phone in front of the headline), tally glow

iconography.style: minimal line glyphs + geometric dots (REC dot, slot dots)
iconography.preferred_set: inline custom SVG (arrow, check, star-burst); no icon library

motion.easing: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) signature (GSAP expo.out) for 80% of motion; cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.84, 0) exits; cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) on-screen moves; elastic.out(1, 0.4) reserved for magnetic release
motion.entrance_pattern: masked line rise: each line slides up 110% from behind its own clip mask while settling a 3deg tilt; supporting copy follows 120-160ms later with a 24px rise + fade
motion.exit_pattern: fade + 12px rise at 70% of the entrance duration (ease-in)
motion.philosophy: cinematic, scroll-as-playhead: long sequences are scrubbed to scroll position, short UI feedback is snappy; one ambient layer always alive (orbiting cards, dust, tally breathing) at <=20% of the primary motion's energy

components.button_style: 56px pill; primary = tally fill, ink label, live dot; ghost = 1px bone hairline; both magnetic on fine pointers with inner-label parallax
components.input_style: n/a (mailto conversion); if added: 56px ink field, 1px hairline, tally focus ring
components.card_style: dark glass slab: #0E1014 to #161920 gradient, 1px hairline with bright top edge, 28px radius, oversized outline numeral
components.navigation_pattern: floating top bar: wordmark with REC dot, center timecode (page = 30s reel) + live section label, tally CTA right; 1px scroll progress line
components.list_style: ruled rows with mono index / check glyphs
components.component_notes: Tabs: mono labels with a sliding tally underline (transform only). Price card: rotating conic hairline border (transform rotate) + pointer tilt. Orb CTA: ink disc with rotating text ring.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A late-night broadcast studio. The red tally light means you're live; the page itself is a 30-second reel scrubbed by the scroll; content cards orbit your phone and get dealt into it, ready to post.
aesthetic.era_influence: 2026 post-glass 3D web, broadcast/NLE editing UI, Swiss grotesk scale

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle accents (timecodes, ruler ticks, REC dots, film grain)
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: bottom-left heavy type vs right-side 3D mass; single hot accent always at the focal point
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive reveal: one hero element per viewport, the rest dimmed
visual_language.texture_usage: static film grain at 5% + scanlines inside screens

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast + width-axis contrast + tally color weight
composition.flow_direction: vertical with one horizontal timeline chapter (how it works)
composition.grouping_strategy: stacked glass slabs, ruled lists, console/tab groupings
composition.negative_space_role: the dark studio void that the 3D and type float in

imagery.photo_treatment: none; no stock photos (the work is shown as written)
imagery.illustration_style: UI-as-illustration: phone screens, script timelines, caption mocks, week plans
imagery.graphic_elements: REC dot, tally glow, ruler ticks, timecodes, outline numerals, star-burst separator

interaction_feel.feedback_style: physical: magnetic pull, lift + glow, cursor morphs to state labels
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: lift 2-4px, hairline brightens, glow blooms; 160ms in / 240ms out
interaction_feel.loading_style: static CSS poster first, 3D fades in when ready; never a blocking preloader
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: medium-high on desktop pointer, low on touch

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: friendly invitation with zero-risk framing (free sample week)
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: honest emptiness as a design element (the empty testimonial wall)

overview.fallback_strategy: static CSS poster when WebGL/CDN unavailable or Save-Data/2G; reduced-motion = single rendered 3D frame, no scrub/pin/loops/cursor; DPR caps + adaptive DPR on frame-time spikes; render loop paused offscreen/hidden tab

background_effects.description: Static film grain over the whole page plus a breathing tally glow behind the hero phone and radial vignettes per section
background_effects.technology: CSS (SVG feTurbulence data-URI) + WebGL additive halo plane

particle_systems.description: Studio dust: soft round motes drifting upward in a deep shell around the phone, ~8% of them tally-hot

params.movement_pattern: slow upward drift with wraparound + sine sway
params.color_behavior: ice-white majority, tally minority, depth-faded alpha

3d_elements.description: Titanium phone with a live shader screen; six glass reel cards (HOOK, SCRIPT, CAPTION, #HASHTAGS, MON 7:30PM, WEEK 02) orbit it, get dealt out on load, and converge back into the phone as you scroll until the screen reads READY TO POST

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer alpha:true, ACESFilmic, sRGB output, DPR cap 1.75 desktop / 1.5 mobile, adaptive DPR, antialias only when DPR < 2
params.lighting: RoomEnvironment PMREM IBL (0.55) + white key directional + tally point rim (behind right) + ice point fill; no shadow maps
params.camera: PerspectiveCamera fov 30, z 11, damped pointer parallax
params.materials: MeshPhysicalMaterial titanium (metalness .85, clearcoat); glass cards MeshPhysicalMaterial transparent + clearcoat + iridescence (desktop) with onBeforeCompile fresnel rim; ShaderMaterial screen + halo + points
params.geometry: ExtrudeGeometry from rounded-rect Shapes (bevelled), PlaneGeometry labels with atlas UVs, CapsuleGeometry camera island, BufferGeometry points
post_processing: none: additive halo plane + fresnel rims instead of UnrealBloomPass, so the canvas stays transparent over the DOM headline and mobile GPUs skip full-screen passes
params.interaction_model: pointer parallax (rig + camera counter-motion), raycast hover lift + rim glow + cursor label, mouse drag spin with inertia, scroll-scrubbed convergence

shader_effects.description: Phone screen: fbm value-noise tally plume, rounded-rect SDF mask, scanlines, playback bar, glass sheen sweep, crossfade LIVE -> READY TO POST UI atlas. Glass fresnel rim injected into MeshPhysicalMaterial.

parallax.depth_range: ghost price numerals 0.2x, section glows 0.5x, content 1x

scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: clip-reveal masked lines, fade-up, stack-scale, rotateX flip-in
scroll_triggered_animations.scrub_behavior: hero + how-it-works + card stack scrubbed (scrub 0.6-1); text reveals triggered once

scroll_morphing.description: Hero pin: orbiting cards converge into the phone, phone turns to face camera and slides center, screen crossfades to READY TO POST. How it works: vertical scroll becomes a horizontal NLE timeline with a tally playhead. Nav timecode maps the whole page to a 00:00-00:30 reel.

text_effects.description: SplitText with line masks for every display heading; hero splits to chars for a 22ms cascade

cursor_effects.description: Instant dot + lagging ring; ring grows over links, shows labels ('Drag', card names, 'Email') over 3D and CTAs; magnetic buttons with inner-label parallax

params.interaction_zone: fine pointers only; magnetic radius = element bounds + 24px

image_effects.description: Price card and brief card tilt toward the pointer with a moving spotlight
image_effects.technology: GSAP quickTo on rotateX/rotateY + translated radial glow

params.blur_radius: 18px (static nav/brief only; never on animated layers)

canvas_drawings.description: 2D canvas draws the card-label atlas and the phone screen UI states (LIVE/READY) once, after fonts load, as CanvasTextures

params.animation_loop: none (static atlas; motion lives in the shader)

svg_animations.description: Rotating text ring on the orb CTA, spinning star-burst in the marquee (velocity-driven), check glyph draws in the price list

params.animation_method: CSS/GSAP transform rotate; stroke-dashoffset for checks

visual_effects.composite_notes: Layer order in the hero is deliberate: DOM headline (z1) < transparent WebGL canvas (z2) < DOM UI (z3), so the phone and glass cards physically pass in front of the giant type. That is why bloom is faked with an additive halo and fresnel rims rather than an EffectComposer pass (which would force an opaque canvas). All DOM motion is transform/opacity only; SplitText masks, sticky stacking, and the horizontal track use translate/scale. Three.js loads after window load/idle and is skipped on Save-Data/2G; the CSS poster is the permanent fallback.
